# Quarter-card picture-card comparisons

These complete 66 by 89 RGB crops are byte-original, card-relative (3, 4), from retained native 1920 by 1080 images. `provenance.json` records card identities, origins and source/crop SHA-256 values. Full original PNGs and metadata are privately preserved with the 170 build evidence. Row-7 cards are fully exposed; the Coral Jacks are exposed because both original child slots are empty in the retained expected state.

Every same-theme pair uses all RGB absolute deltas strictly greater than 13, alpha ignored. All seven comparisons exceed 293 of 5,874 pixels (strictly greater than 5%). These are aligned face-to-face artwork controls, not actual before/after guest transitions, recogniser coverage, acquisition authority or live acceptance. They cover all six same-colour picture-card suit comparisons across the retained artwork families. Coral specifically covers JC/JS and KH/KD; JH/JD, QC/QS, QH/QD and KC/KS remain unmeasured in Coral. No colour or geometry threshold was selected by searching these images.

The failed Coral 7C-to-7S Recon transition has no retained immediate pre-D image, so its new-quarter percentage remains unknown. The separate 31 by 49 quiet-settling rule is unchanged.
